title: Front Cover
content: A female broad-snouted caiman (Caiman latirostris) attending her nest in Cacique Ariacaiquin, Santa Fe, Argentina. The image relates to Short Communication “Integrating camera-trap photo-identification into non-invasive monitoring of Caiman latirostris” [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70405]. Photo credit: Sofía Evelyn Pierini.
